title: Lekalo validation success receipt
description: Closed contract of the `lekalo validate` success receipt (issue #34 provider boundary, fix round 1). The command embeds no `schemaVersion` member in its payload; this describing schema is the exact output negotiation target advertised as `lekalo/validation-report/v0.6.3` by the workflow-provider manifest. The envelope is the standard status-first projection: exit 0, stdout. Warning/info validation findings ride the envelope's `diagnostics` array (closed `lekalo/diagnostic/v0.2.16` items); error findings make the run `invalid` (exit 1, stderr) which is a semantic result, not a provider crash. `lekalo/validation-profile/v0.4.0` remains the separate profile *configuration* schema and is pinned alongside this contract.

status.description: Always valid on this success stream; the projection of a completed validation run carrying only warning/info diagnostics.

modelVersion.description: The exact canonical Model contract version that was validated.

profile.description: The closed built-in profile id that ran (`default` or `strict`).

profileVersion.description: The exact profile document version that ran.

registryVersion.description: The exact diagnostic registry version the findings resolve against.

moduleScope.description: Present only for a `--module`-scoped run; the module semantic id scope.

rulesEnabled.description: The number of rules the profile enabled.
